title: TCGA-A8-A081
limitations: Cluster count is chosen from structure, never from survival.
Exploratory k views render curves without p-values.
Dose-response values are measured GDSC viabilities, not a simulation.
Adjacent-normal references can show field effects.
The latent space is a PCA of the intrinsic gene set, not the committed VAE encoding.

takeaways.survival: The 4 subgroups differ in overall survival (p = 0.038).
takeaways.projection: This patient falls in Subgroup 1 (100% membership).
takeaways.characteristics: Subgroup 1 has no pathway passing q < 0.05 versus the rest of the cohort.
takeaways.retrieval: 5 cell lines resemble this tumour. Signature reversal is withheld. Compounds are shown as evidence, not as recommendations.
